0022600116.text: The Clippers (1-0, 1st in the Pacific) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, 1st in the Northwest), with both teams in the West. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee, inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), while Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (back, surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Clippers lost 0-3 to Oklahoma City in the 2025-26 season series, including a 128-110 loss in Los Angeles on April 8, 2026.
